sentences.en: I couldn't in my wildest dreams imagine myself wearing fur.
sentences.zh: 我做梦也没想到自己会穿毛皮衣服。

sentences.en: The new fur coats were displayed in the window.
sentences.zh: 新出的皮草外套在橱窗里展示着。

sentences.en: I think it is cruel to trap animals for fur coats.
sentences.zh: 我觉得为了做皮大衣而捕猎动物是残忍的。

senses.zh: 软毛，毛皮，裘皮，毛皮服饰，毛皮制品
